record.original_question: Find conditions on a holomorphic vector field Z on C2 that guarantee every leaf is covered by the unit disc.

evidence.quote: Problem 8.1. Let Z be a holomorphic vector field in C2. (iii) Find conditions which imply that all leaves are covered by the unit disc.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $Z$ be a holomorphic vector field on $\mathbb{C}^2$, and consider the singular holomorphic foliation $\mathcal{F}_Z$ of $\mathbb{C}^2$ whose regular leaves are the maximal integral curves of $Z$ away from the singular set $\mathrm{Sing}(Z)=\{p\in\mathbb{C}^2 : Z(p)=0\}$. Each leaf $L$ of $\mathcal{F}_Z$ is a connected Riemann surface, and by the uniformization theorem its universal cover is biholomorphic to either the Riemann sphere $\widehat{\mathbb{C}}$, the complex plane $\mathbb{C}$, or the unit disc $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$ (in which case $L$ is called hyperbolic).

Find explicit conditions on the holomorphic vector field $Z$ on $\mathbb{C}^2$ that guarantee that every leaf of $\mathcal{F}_Z$ is hyperbolic, i.e., that the universal cover of every leaf is biholomorphic to the unit disc $\mathbb{D}$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open question concerning holomorphic vector fields on $\mathbb{C}^2$. Related partial results are known: for foliations by curves on $\mathbb{CP}^n$ of degree $\geq 2$ with only non-degenerate singularities, all leaves are uniformized by the Poincaré disc (Brunella, Lins Neto, and others). However, for general holomorphic vector fields on $\mathbb{C}^2$, no complete characterization of when all leaves are covered by the unit disc appears in the literature, and the problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: Simultaneous uniformization for the leaves of projective foliations by curves
status_evidence.snippet: For foliations by curves on CP^n of degree d≥2 with non-degenerate singularities, all leaves are uniformized by the Poincaré disk.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist for projective foliations, but the question for general holomorphic vector fields on C^2 remains open.

status_evidence.title: Uniformizable foliated projective structures along singular foliations
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work continues to study uniformization of leaves of singular holomorphic foliations.
status_evidence.claim: The uniformization problem for leaves of singular holomorphic foliations is an active research topic.

status_evidence.title: Local Theory of Holomorphic Foliations and Vector Fields
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of local theory; the global uniformization-type questions remain difficult.
status_evidence.claim: Conditions ensuring all leaves are hyperbolic are not fully characterized for vector fields on C^2.
